qualification.lvs: Strict captured SKY130 HD device/body/port comparison passed; see sky130_lvs scope.

physical_checks.scope: Final OpenDB default-oxide LEF antenna rules and all declared POWER/GROUND net connectivity. Model/rule presence is checked; deck adequacy, streamed-GDS DRC/LVS, density, ERC, ESD/latch-up, IR drop and electromigration are not qualified by these checks. Logic inputs require positive gate area; declared CORE ANTENNACELL inputs require positive diffusion area, retained separately in the coverage report.

qualification.scope: LEF/GDS geometry with the actual gate netlist and captured SPEF. No characterized macro Liberty model is implied.

sky130_native.scope: Generic SKY130 AL-backend FEOL, BEOL and off-grid geometry on the exact final GDS. Block context: seal checking is deferred to complete-chip qualification. The deck floating-metal option is off; Studio device-root connectivity and LVS remain separate obligations. SRAM_EXCLUDE is false, but upstream built-in cell filters remain. Density, antenna, LVS, special-device coverage and full signoff are not established by this report.

sky130_rules.scope: Six reviewed drawn-mask geometry/connectivity profiles and the 601-row periphery ledger. This is partial coverage: native decks, full antenna, density, error-catalog reconciliation, device/body LVS and electrical acceptance remain separate. SKY130 signoff is not qualified.

sky130_density.scope: Mandatory project density policy for every new SKY130 HD Finish, independent of the fill-generation setting. Both retained public growth profiles must pass every full 700 um window, stepped 70 um from independently captured layout bounds. Clipped observations are diagnostic. A block without full windows requires surrounding layout and receives no density acceptance. These public profiles do not establish foundry applicability, final-mask density, metal-5 density, complete-chip boundaries or complete physical qualification.

sky130_fill.scope: Local metal fill on the five-metal SKY130A HD stack. Every exported fill rectangle is compared with the implementation database; widths, area, spacing, grid and signal clearance are independently checked. Full 700 um windows use the two retained public 80% grown-metal profiles. Smaller blocks require surrounding layout; clipped edge observations are diagnostic. This is not complete density, generated-mask, electrical or foundry signoff. Routed OpenRCX SPEF is retained, but floating-fill coupling has not been qualified.

sky130_lvs.scope: Local final-GDS device, body and boundary-port connectivity against an independent final-OpenDB and reviewed HD CDL reference. Four-terminal 1.8 V NMOS/PMOS and the independently referenced diode_2 antenna cell are compared, including dimensions. Port labels are encoded on a mask-identical copy; pin annotations are not conductors. No blanket supply ties, port equivalences or device blackboxes. This does not establish complete device-family, density, parasitic, electrical, complete-chip or foundry qualification.

sky130_antenna.scope: Thirteen staged antenna checks on the captured SKY130 five-metal HD MOS layout. The reviewed supplemental deck retains its published met5 description discrepancy. Other devices, process options, complete physical coverage and foundry signoff remain unqualified.

sky130_isolation.scope: SKY130 x.29: C3 NFET gate containment in drawn deep nwell when explicitly requested. Bulk mode retains measurements as NOT_REQUESTED. Other well rules, body connectivity, electrical checks and complete physical qualification remain separate.
